summary: Consolidated Casework Intake and Authorization for Release of Information form bundle for California Assemblymember Tom Lackey (District 34). This packet allows his local office staff to receive personal details, open a formal constituent casework file, and communicate directly with state departments (such as CDSS, DHCS, or DPSS) to resolve ongoing administrative default or eligibility disputes.
